Headline: #85 Central buses Temporary Reroute at Central/Wabansia
ShortDescription: The #85 Central buses are temporarily rerouted due to police activity near Central/Wabansia.

FullDescription.#cdata-section:
How does this affect my trip?

#85 Central buses are temporarily rerouted in both directions via Central, North Avenue, Austin, Grand, Central and over regular route.

Allow extra travel time.

Why is service being changed?

Buses are rerouted due to police activity near Central/Wabansia.
